dedupe_keys.name: sinaloa fifty station precipitation and temperature series 1933 2025

description: This Mendeley Data release compiles long-term observations from fifty meteorological stations across Sinaloa, Mexico. The station operators include CONAGUA, the Mexican National Meteorological Service and Universidad Autónoma de Sinaloa. Source records span 1933–2025 and chiefly report precipitation, evaporation, and maximum and minimum temperatures. The repository version 4 lists 257 public TXT and CSV files with daily, monthly and annual processed series under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is a collection of station histories, not a uniform complete ninety-two-year record at every location or a gridded climate projection. Station gaps and any documented infilling are limitations for flood, drought and water-balance modelling. A reviewer-assessed use is providing observed rainfall or temperature forcing to regional hydrology and irrigation simulations. data-hydrosheds-hydrorivers-hydrobasins is a related hydrographic reference, but no catchment-to-station mapping was verified. The article and repository metadata were inspected without downloading any observations.
